sample_unit: medical scenarios (each in two bias-framed versions)

links.outcome: Response discrepancy between bias-framed versions of the same scenario across models
links.effect: DeepSeek-R1 mitigated 6 of 10 biases via all-or-none responses; 4 persisted: post hoc fallacy (34% vs 0%), decoy effects (44% vs 5%), Occam's razor (100% vs 0%), hindsight bias (56% vs 0%).
links.quote: The four biases that persisted were post hoc fallacy (34% vs 0%, p<0.001), decoy effects (44% vs 5%, p<0.001), Occam's razor fallacy (100% vs 0%, p<0.001) and hindsight bias (56% vs 0%, p<0.001).

unlisted_practices: Testing chain-of-thought reasoning LLMs for cognitive bias susceptibility (framing, decoy, hindsight effects) in clinical decision scenarios
Measuring LLM response intransigence (Shannon entropy) and deviance from practicing physician responses

screen.reason: Evaluates cognitive bias and intransigence in reasoning LLMs across medical vignettes compared to human physicians without evaluating a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
